usage: python train_lora.py --model qwen|deepseek|llama --out /root/shared-nvme/AI4FinRuntime/runs/FRESH_DIR; default only prints a CPU plan. Optional --execute starts a deliberate future reproduction on Linux after prerequisites are available. No fresh reproduction was started while preparing this component.
llama_reproduction: Derive new frozen plan and isolated bundle from the actual executed plan; preserve original plan/run. Actual preflight holds GPU lock, verifies weights/environment/full targets, saves data-access receipts before loading GPU.
qwen_deepseek_reproduction: Preserved backend and legacy dispatch; reproduces original methodology issues. This new wrapper does not repair data or old DeepSeek target.
utils: Original starter helper bodies retained. utils.tokenize clips data and is not used by actual backend preprocessing; split_target_contract is separate. Architecture q/v entries are supplemental.
environment: Original Linux data volume /root/shared-nvme/AI4FinRuntime with existing pinned sources/prepared data/HF cache/venv. Source paths in config must exist; no automatic installer/downloader.
quantization: 8-bit single GPU, not a DeepSpeed configuration.
reproduction_guarantee_asymmetry: Qwen/DeepSeek legacy dispatch checks backend/dependency/prepared-data hashes and GPU serialization, but does not rehash base weights or enforce installed library versions. Llama preflight additionally enforces weight hashes, exact expected library versions and all1230 target re-encodings. These are asymmetric guarantees; neither new dispatch path was GPU-executed for this packaging.
contract_version: V3 exact executed contract; superseded V2 file removed from this derived bundle
